competences.description: Attacks the enemy 3 times with a whirling gust of darkness. Stuns the enemy for 1 turn with a 20% chance.

effets.description: The target will be stunned and won't be able to attack.

competences.description: Shoots two arrows to attack a target enemy and a random enemy. Guarantees to stun the enemy if both arrows hit the same target.

effets.description: The target will be stunned and won't be able to attack.
effets.note: If both arrows hit same target

effets.description: Bypasses all enemy resistances when applying effects.
effets.note: For stun, if all hits go into one enemy

competences.description: Inflicts damage on the enemy with a curse, increasing the enemy's chance of dealing a Glancing Hit for 3 turns.

effets.description: The chance of landing a glancing hit will be increased by 50%. Glancing Hits will decrease the damage by 30% and if the attacker has attribute disadvantage, damage will be decreased additionally by 16%.
